run_train_dinotxt: run the DINOTxt training loop via CLI with a trainer config file and output directory
train_DINOTxt_model: train a DINOTxt vision-text model using CLIP contrastive loss and optional gram loss
test_DINOTxt_checkpoint: test and save a DINOTxt model checkpoint to an evaluation directory at a given iteration
write_config_DINOTxtConfig: write a DINOTxtConfig object to a YAML file in the specified output directory
exclude_optimizer_params: exclude bias, batch norm, layer norm, and logit scale parameters from weight decay
